title: Transactions
subtitle: Record your daily income and expenses
needWalletAndCategory: You need at least 1 wallet and 1 category before recording a transaction.
needWallet: You need at least 1 wallet before recording a transaction.
needCategory: You need at least 1 category before recording a transaction.
privateMaskedHint: Another member's private transaction — its details are hidden. Its amount still counts in wallet balances and overall reports.
privateHint: Only you can see this transaction (not even the household owner). Its amount still counts in wallet balances and overall reports.

noUsableWallet: You have no wallet to record into — every existing wallet belongs to another member. Ask the household owner to assign you a wallet or create a shared one.
deleteConfirm: Delete this transaction? You can restore it later from Trash.
importHint: The import file must match the export file format (columns: Time, Wallet, Category, Type, Amount, Note) — you can export a sample file first and edit it.
bulkDeleteConfirm: Delete {{count}} selected transaction(s)? They can be restored later from the Trash.
selectAllAria: Select all transactions on this page
historySubtitle: Who created, edited, deleted or restored this transaction, and what changed.
historyEmpty: No history yet — this transaction was created before change tracking existed.
replaceReceiptConfirm: Replace the current receipt with "{{file}}"? The old one will be deleted.
importConfirm: Import transactions from "{{file}}"? Every valid row becomes a new transaction.
